models_evaluated: deep learning algorithm predicting COVID-19 disease severity from laboratory markers and age

links.outcome: Model discrimination and NPV across external datasets and pre-Omicron versus Omicron periods
links.effect: Concordance index 0.71 to 0.81 across all datasets; NPV of 0.78 or higher for severe patients in ACH cohort in both eras, consistent with development cohort.
links.quote: In the ACH cohort, a negative predictive value (NPV) of 0.78 or higher was observed for severe patients in both the pre-Omicron and Omicron eras, which is consistent with the algorithm's performance in the development cohort.

screen.reason: The study conducts retrospective external validation of a deep learning predictive risk algorithm across different temporal eras (pre-Omicron and Omicron) and international datasets, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
